279786.rationale: Community Shield is Arsenal (PL champions, 85 pts) v Manchester City (FA Cup winners), Sun 16 Aug 2026, 15:00, Principality Stadium, Cardiff. A draw goes to penalties, so this is close to a coin flip. Arsenal get a slight edge from title odds (6/4 v 5/2) and continuity, while City are rebuilding under new manager Maresca after Guardiola, Bernardo Silva, Stones and Ederson left.
279786.next_info: Summer transfers (Julian Alvarez to Arsenal?, Elliot Anderson to City?) and pre-season form in late July/early Aug; match odds ~Aug 10-15; result 16 Aug.

72132.rationale: Forest's opener is Nottingham Forest v Leeds United, Sat 22 Aug 15:00, City Ground. The sides are evenly matched: Forest finished 16th with 44 pts under Vitor Pereira, Leeds 14th with 47 pts under Farke, and both are 500/1 for the title and about 6/1 to be relegated. Forest have home advantage, and Leeds have not won at the City Ground since 2017.
72132.next_info: Forest sales (Elliot Anderson to Man City, Gibbs-White), Leeds signings; match odds mid-Aug; result 22 Aug.

97251.rationale: United open at Hull City on Sat 22 Aug at 12:30. Hull came up through the play-offs and are heavy relegation favourites (1/4). United finished third with 71 pts and Michael Carrick is now permanent head coach. An away opener and World Cup fatigue keep the draw and an upset live.
97251.next_info: United summer signings, World Cup player returns; match odds ~Aug 15-20; result 22 Aug.

79046.rationale: The fixture list puts Aston Villa v Arsenal in MD2 on Sat 29 Aug; the question's 31 Aug is probably a TV move to the Bank Holiday Monday. Arsenal are champions (85 pts) and Villa finished 4th (65 pts) and won the Europa League. Villa Park is a tough venue, where Villa beat Arsenal 2-1 in Dec 2025.
79046.next_info: TV pick confirmation (date), transfers, MD1 results (Arsenal v Coventry 21 Aug; Brighton v Villa 23 Aug); result ~29-31 Aug.

5814.rationale: Aston Villa v Nottingham Forest is MD4, Sat 12 Sep 15:00 at Villa Park. Villa (4th, 65 pts, Champions League) are much stronger than Forest (16th, 44 pts), but Villa's European schedule (UCL MD1 is 8-10 Sep) and Forest's improvement under Pereira (Europa League semi-finals) narrow the gap.
5814.next_info: Early-season form MD1-3 (Forest: Leeds H, Liverpool A, Spurs H; Villa: Brighton A, Arsenal H, Hull A); UCL fixture dates; result 12 Sep.

487575.rationale: Man Utd v Man City is MD4, scheduled Sat 12 Sep at Old Trafford (could move to the 13th for TV). City were stronger last season (78 v 71 pts, GD +42 v +19) and are shorter in the title betting (5/2 v 13/2). Against that, City are in transition under Maresca with key departures, United are at home, and United beat City 2-0 at Old Trafford in Jan 2026.
487575.next_info: Transfers, first 3 matchdays' form, City 115-charges verdict (morale/points), TV date; result 12/13 Sep.

297571.rationale: The La Liga fixture list comes out 30 Jun 2026, so the derby's host is unknown. Atletico hosted the first-half derby in each of the last four seasons (late Sep). Real Madrid (86 pts, new manager Mourinho, plus Bernardo Silva, Konate, Cucurella and Dumfries) are clearly stronger on paper than Atletico (69 pts), who lost Griezmann and are likely losing Julian Alvarez. Madrid derbies draw often.
297571.next_info: 30 Jun fixture release (who hosts; if Metropolitano shift toward ATM ~0.35/0.28/0.37; if Bernabeu RM ~0.52); Julian Alvarez transfer; early-season form; result 20 Sep.

284913.rationale: The table will be roughly 5-6 matchdays old (season starts 15-16 Aug; international break on the 26 Sep and 3 Oct weekends). Barcelona are back-to-back champions (94 pts, Flick) but lost Lewandowski, and Real Madrid (86) are heavily strengthened under Mourinho. Other clubs top the early table in about 1 season in 4-5. Ties are decided on goal difference early in the season.
284913.next_info: 30 Jun fixture list (early schedules difficulty), transfers (Julian Alvarez to Barca?), standings after MD1-5 (Aug 16 - Sep 13); result 20 Sep.

568969.rationale: Mbappe won the 2025-26 Pichichi with 25 league goals (8 pens) in 31 games, about a third of Madrid's 77 league goals; Vinicius scored 16. Betis (5th, UCL) were led by Cucho Hernandez (11) and Fornals (9). Two of the last four league meetings at the Villamarin ended 0-0, so the no-goal outcome gets about 7%.
568969.next_info: 30 Jun fixture list (exact matchday), Vinicius future/transfers, Mbappe fitness; lineups day of match; result Sept 2026.

541001.rationale: At the World Cup break the East read: Nashville 33 pts (14 GP, 10-1-3), Inter Miami 31 (15 GP), Chicago 26 (14 GP), New England 25 (14 GP). Nashville lead by 2 points with a game in hand and resume on 17 Jul v Atlanta. Roughly 5-7 MLS games remain before 19 Aug, with the Leagues Cup break on 4-13 Aug.
541001.next_info: MLS restart 16-18 Jul; results through Aug 19; Messi/World Cup returns, Casemiro/Lewandowski signings.

754377.rationale: Phase One runs 4-13 Aug, and only the top 4 of 18 MLS clubs reach the quarter-finals (25-27 Aug). Miami play all three Phase One games at home: Atletico San Luis (5 Aug), Monterrey (8 Aug) and Leon (12 Aug). Scoring is 3 pts for a win, 2 for a shootout win and 1 for a shootout loss, so a team needs about 7+ pts. I put Miami's chance of advancing at about 40%. The resolution date of 12 Aug, the day of Miami's last group game, slightly favours a Phase One exit.
754377.next_info: Phase One results Aug 5/8/12 (resolves early if eliminated); QF Aug 25-27, SF Sep 1-2, Final Sep 6.

753240.rationale: Inter Miami, the MLS Cup 2025 champions, host the Campeones Cup on Wed 16 Sep at Nu Stadium. Their opponent is the winner of Toluca (Apertura 2025) v Cruz Azul (Clausura 2026) in the Campeon de Campeones, 25 Jul in Carson, CA. A draw goes to penalties. Historically it is MLS 3, Liga MX 4, with the last three won by Liga MX sides (2023-25, two of them on penalties).
753240.next_info: Campeon de Campeones result Jul 25 (then reallocate Liga MX mass to winner ~0.43-0.45); Miami form/Messi fitness; result Sep 16.
